_comment: WHY x Yellow strategy -> Bybit DEMO Trading. Signals come ONLY from the Yellow mark-candle shadow (/opt/why-yellow-markshadow) which runs the UNCHANGED production strategy on completed 5m Yellow mark candles. Orders go ONLY to https://api-demo.bybit.com (guard.py fails closed on any other host).

sizing._comment: Production Yellow book: fixed WY_CLIP_USD=2000 notional per position at 10x, WY_MAX_OPEN=8. Same fixed clip here so demo P&L is 1:1 comparable with the Yellow shadow book. qty = floor(clip / bybit mark / qtyStep) * qtyStep; below minOrderQty -> signal skipped.

exits._comment: TP/SL are exchange-side on Bybit demo (tpslMode Full, MarkPrice trigger, market fill), set from the actual demo fill price with the sleeve's tp_pct/sl_pct (WY_RV_TP/SL, WY_PB_TP/SL read from the production strategy, never hardcoded here). TIMEOUT = production WY_TIMEOUT_BARS x 5m from entry, closed with a reduce-only market order.
